'''2011 Belgium Regionals Floris de Vries DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Floris de Vries]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' SYCFA
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
